results.content:
This will happen to all sticker packs except the Lucky and Wild Stickers.. Also, duplicate sticker stars earned do not carry over to the next Album.  
  
NEW addition! (Recompletion Album)Bonus Album or Recompletion Albumwill open after completing the main Sticker Album.You can get stickers for the Bonus Album or Recompletion Album from opening all types of Sticker Packs obtained in the game. The album can be completed up to 3 times. First, the main album, and then twice for recompletion. [...] Gold packs: Contains 4 sticker cards. (minimum of 1 - 3 stars sticker)

Diamond Packs: Contains 4 sticker cards. (minimum of 1 - 4 stars)

Magical Packs: Contains 4 sticker cards. (one 5-star sticker card guaranteed -can be duplicate-)

Epic Packs:Contains a single card of the epic set. [...] Targeted Lucky Packs: these special lucky packs contain an unowned (ONE) sticker with a determined rarity depending on the number of stars shown.  Please note that you can get a duplicate sticker if you already own all of the identified rarities.

Can carry over (not theme bound)

Lucky Packs: Contains 1 sticker card. (one unowned sticker card guaranteed, Does not include Epic Set Sticker Cards)
